# External Documentation

Public-facing documentation intended for external users and developers.

This folder is for documentation that will be shared with:
- Frontend developers integrating with the API
- Contributors or collaborators
- Public users accessing services

## Current External Docs

External documentation is currently maintained in:
- [Website Backend API](../api/website-backend-api.md) - API documentation for frontend integration
- [Website Integration Guide](../website-integration.md) - How to integrate with the backend

This folder is reserved for future external documentation that needs to be separated from internal system docs.
